name: io.github.robd-hub/cheap-first
title: Cheap First
description: Answers cheaply first, then escalates to a premium model only when a checker fails.

tools.name: ask_cheap_first
tools.description: Answer a question the Cheap First way: Dolphin answers, another cheap sample checks numbers and choices, SERV Reasoning grades anything else, and a premium model answers instead only if the check misses the pass mark. Returns the answer, whether it escalated, the check score, the cost and the estimated saving. Free calls use the public demo limits (600 characters, 10 an hour per IP, 300 a day). Send Authorization: Bearer cf_... or an x402 payment of $0.005 USDC on Base for the paid limits (2000 characters). To receive the x402 challenge, send the header X-Cheap-First-Paid: 1. mode: strict escalates more often (pass mark 85), balanced is the default (75), budget escalates less often (60).

question.description: The question. 600 characters on the free demo, 2000 when paid.

mode.description: strict, balanced (default) or budget. Unknown values are treated as balanced.

tools.name: cheap_first_stats
tools.description: Published benchmark figures from the saved result files. The in-house run, the harder run graded by code, and the public GSM8K and ARC-Challenge run when that file is complete. The public summary includes accuracy, cost, escalation, latency, and where the checker missed. Does not call a model.
